Agent Island v0.11.1 adds real Codex quota visibility and makes the expanded workspace feel immediate.

### What's new

- Shows Codex quota remaining, usage percentage, and reset time from local Codex session records.
- Shows context-window usage and plan information when those fields are available.
- Marks connected agents without readable quota data as unavailable instead of inventing an estimate.
- Displays compact quota chips in hover and workspace views.
- Opens a fixed-size workspace shell immediately, renders only the active page, and prefetches Work, Todos, and Clipboard data while idle.
- Refreshes the interface with Chinese desktop copy while keeping English and Chinese repository documentation.

### Privacy

- Quota data is read from local Codex `token_count` records and kept in process memory.
- No new outbound network request, telemetry, analytics, or cloud account was added.
- Prompt text remains visible by default to identify the active task; reasoning content is not read.
- Clipboard history remains memory-only, and Windows notification capture remains off by default.

### Windows download notice

The portable x64 build is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen may show an “Unknown publisher” warning. Verify the accompanying `.sha256` file before running the executable, or build from source.

Please report bugs in Issues and share integration feedback in Discussions. Do not post private prompts, clipboard contents, notification text, tokens, account details, or local paths.
